exam_name: Blazing Fox Launch - AI Engineer L1
essay_prompt: Explain how an enterprise should evaluate adopting generative AI for a regulated business process. Cover business value, governance, architecture, risk, delivery execution, and optionally pseudocode.
essay_response:
Business Value
Assess ROI through cost savings, productivity gains, and revenue opportunities. Pilot use cases in regulated processes like compliance reporting to quantify benefits vs. alternatives.
Governance
Establish AI policies aligned with regulations (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA). Form cross-functional committees for oversight, ethical guidelines, and audit trails.
Architecture
Design scalable, secure integration with existing systems. Use hybrid cloud setups, APIs for GenAI models, ensuring data isolation and interoperability.
Risk
Identify biases, hallucinations, data leaks. Conduct risk assessments, implement controls like human-in-loop, and monitor for regulatory compliance violations.
Delivery Execution
Adopt agile methodology: start with MVP, test in sandbox, iterate with feedback. Train teams, ensure change management, and scale post-validation.

scenario_prompt: A finance organization wants to automate document-heavy review while maintaining auditability. Propose an AI solution covering workflow, controls, architecture, and operational ownership.
scenario_response:
Solution Overview
Deploy GenAI-powered knowledge platform for field service: AI-assisted diagnostics, resolution recommendations, and automated reporting.
Business Value
Reduces resolution times by 30-50% via instant knowledge access; boosts reuse through AI-curated case libraries, cutting repeat visits.
Governance
AI ethics board oversees usage; comply with regs via role-based access, data anonymization.
Architecture
Integrate GenAI (e.g., LLM models) with CRM/ERP systems; use edge computing for mobile apps, secure APIs for data flow.
Risk
Mitigate hallucinations with verified sources; implement bias checks, data encryption to prevent leaks.
Delivery Execution
Pilot with small team: build MVP in 4-6 weeks, test in field, iterate with metrics on time savings; scale with training.
